::: {.wm-bio}
I study probabilistic issues in Number Theory and Cryptography, particularly related to supersingular elliptic curves and quaternion algebras.
:::

<figure class="wm-graph" id="wm-graph" data-src="assets/data/isogeny-graphs.json">

    <span class="wm-graph-caption" id="wm-graph-caption">Supersingular isogeny graphs: the objects I study.</span>
    <span class="wm-graph-stats"></span>
